cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says hubs with programmes for tech startups are in service in two or more cities: the Blantyre programme is the stock exchange's incubation of SMEs, not shown to be for tech startups. No technology park with tenants is on record.
cells.note: Stage 4c 2026-11-15: UNDP's Growth Accelerator launched its ninth and tenth cohorts in Lilongwe in April 2025 (MWI-007) and the stock exchange's Mzinga programme graduated a first cohort in Blantyre (MWI-006), so 2 to 3. Mzinga incubates SMEs for listing rather than tech startups, so the second city is not shown and not 4.
